description: Moss-covered rocks in Puzzlewood, Forest of Dean, Gloucestershire, England (© Fulcanelli_AOS/Getty Images)
A woman with blonde hair stands with her back to the camera as her reflection in a distorting mirror looks back

In his Dublin, Ireland-based lab, photographer Karl Gaff devised a secret formula using compounds like iron sulfate and urea to make this striking image. After spreading the mixture onto a glass slide, he heated it and then used a polarizing microscope to capture the exact moment it crystallized. The chemical process produced this vivid composition.
